interface.longDescription: Create 1–4 product shots from an attached product image and scene instructions, then animate a selected shot. Exact product and label fidelity is not guaranteed. Results appear in an inline canvas with Open and Download; videos include playback and fullscreen. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Create studio and lifestyle shots of my product.
Animate this product shot with a slow camera move.

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and attach the bottle fixture.
positive.prompt: Create one clean white-background product shot of this bottle.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual attached image, one scene and aspect_ratio 1:1. Return one real image in the inline gallery with its caption and Open, Download and Animate controls. Inspect bottle shape and color; do not promise exact label fidelity.

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and attach the same bottle fixture.
positive.prompt: Create two shots: this bottle on a sunlit kitchen counter and on a picnic table.
positive.expected_behavior: Use two ordered scenes and the attached source. Return two real image URLs with matching captions in the inline gallery.

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and attach the bottle fixture. Tests the maximum supported shot count.
positive.prompt: Create four vertical 9:16 product shots: white studio, marble counter, garden table, and dark dramatic studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Use four scenes and aspect_ratio 9:16. Return exactly four ordered images. Check dimensions and captions; do not submit five or more shots.

positive.description: Use the source bottle image URL; connect the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Create a wide 16:9 studio photo of the bottle at https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8.
positive.expected_behavior: Set image_url to the supplied HTTPS URL, one scene and aspect_ratio 16:9. Return a real wide image displayed inline.

positive.description: First generate one product shot using the attached fixture, then animate that returned image.
positive.prompt: Create one white-background product shot, then animate it for five seconds with a gentle camera orbit.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the real returned image URL for product_animate, duration 5 and camera-motion prompt. Return real video media and display it in the inline player. Verify nonzero duration, playback, fullscreen, Open and Download.

negative.description: Explain purchases are unsupported. Do not create images as a substitute or claim an order.
negative.prompt: Order 500 of these bottles from the supplier for me.

negative.description: Explain CAD/manufacturing export is unsupported. Do not claim a generated photo is a measured model.
negative.prompt: Turn this product photo into a dimensionally exact STEP file for manufacturing.

negative.description: Explain this app animates still images and does not edit an existing video; do not invoke product tools as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from my existing ten-minute product video.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payment transactions are part of this workflow.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with product photography, one to four scene variations, still-image animation and inline image/video controls.
